events.verdict: Booker (PHX) establishes himself in Johnson's (DAL) path prior to the contact.
Johnson (DAL) goes to, not through, Booker's (PHX) space as they come together during the pick.
Cisse (DAL) makes contact with Booker's (PHX) arm and affects his jump shot attempt.
Powell (DAL) establishes himself in Gillespie's (PHX) path prior to the contact.
Brooks (PHX) is moving alongside Johnson's (DAL) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Smith (DAL) brings his hand towards the ball, and the contact with Brooks' (PHX) arm as he passes the ball is marginal.
Smith (DAL) directly contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Booker's hand after the release.
Dunn (PHX) legally contests Poulakidas' (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Gillespie (PHX) makes contact with the ball as Cisse (DAL) secures possession.
Booker (PHX) makes contact with Johnson's (DAL) arm that causes him to lose control of the ball.
Powell (DAL) does not inbound the ball within five seconds.
Ighodaro (PHX) cleanly blocks Cisse's (DAL) shot attempt.

As Brooks (PHX) removes his left arm from the ball, he brings his arm towards Cisse (DAL) to brace for the imminent contact, and contact occurs with Cisse's head/face.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Cisse (DAL) maintains verticality as he defends Brooks' (PHX) shot attempt.
Powell (DAL) does not inbound the ball within five seconds.
